task: B02 — isolated Python, data root and ACP test configuration (B02a env handoff + B02b early package smoke)

runbook_rows.detail: Linux x86_64, 40 cores, Python 3.11.13; git/curl/tar/xz/sha256sum/findmnt/ssh present; ss present at /usr/sbin/ss (not on this shell's PATH). Data root xfs native, writable; 28 GiB free and 35.9M free inodes. Ports 18765/18766 free; production 8765 untouched (HTTP 200).
Dedicated venv /opt/acp2-dev/venvs/b installed editable from /opt/acp2-dev/B with [dev,api,remote]; all three packages import from the frozen worktree after PYTHONPATH unset.

Dedicated controller cwd/config with cluster.execution_mode=local, cluster.nodes=[], isolated run root; acp doctor 10 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 NOT_VERIFIED; acp run serve --help exit 0. No production data or remote directory is referenced.
acceptance-env.sh (mode 0600) re-creates interpreters, PATH order, data root, evidence root, deferred fixtures and the credential-reference convention when sourced in a clean shell.

named_gaps.prerequisite: No bsub/bjobs on the host; local-only configuration is intentional in B02.
C T-08 H2 owns browser launch. B02 only verifies ACP2_BROWSER_PYTHON has playwright 1.63.0 importable.
acp doctor verifies binary path/sanity only. No QC job is run in B02; real science is A/C scenario work.
P5. B02b is the minimal P0 package smoke only.
C worktree advanced while B02 ran (candidate recorded at snapshot time); no cross-plan freeze was performed here.

notes: The default /usr/bin/orca is the GNOME Orca screen reader, not QC ORCA. Doctor rejected it; the controller config pins the real ELF ORCA at /home/redacted-user/orca611/orca.

~/.local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/__editable__.acp-0.2.0.pth points at src (the dirty checkout). The B venv's own site-packages wins on sys.path, and the role matrix asserts every module __file__; role/package tests that must be free of this leak use clean venvs.
The B venv is --system-site-packages by design (inherits numpy/rdkit/fastapi/paramiko); wheel was installed into it on demand to build the P0 package smoke.
Package lifecycle: distribution metadata upgrades 0.2.0 -> 0.2.1; cccp.__version__ stays 0.2.0 because the four-place version constant is source-owned.
